### Bug Description

Configuring request mirroring is working on the side of a workload with the sidecar proxy, however, when you apply the same to a waypoint traffic is NOT mirrored. Below are sample configuration that I used. FYI, mirroring doesn't work with Istio API either (VirtualServices).

kind: HTTPRo…

port: 9080

kind: Service
name: reviews-v1
namespace: bookinfo-backends
port: 9080
weight: 80
- group: ""
kind: Service
name: reviews-v2
namespace: bookinfo-backends
port: 9080
weight: 20
filters:
- type: RequestMirror
requestMirror:
